ينقبض (form VII)
# يَنْقَبِضُ (yanqabiḍu) /jan.qa.bi.dˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# يَنْقَبِضَ (yanqabiḍa) /jan.qa.bi.dˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# يَنْقَبِضْ (yanqabiḍ) /jan.qa.bidˤ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
